verdict.rationale: Airwallex's own Merchant of Record add-on has Airwallex act as the legal seller and manage sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance for each sale, which addresses the story directly. However, it is in beta with limited eligibility and covers digital products only ("Physical goods are not supported"), so it does not cover every transaction. missing for 10: tax handling for physical goods, general availability beyond beta, documentation of how tax is calculated and collected (rates, jurisdictions, invoice line items), tax calculation outside the MoR model, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can calculate and collect the correct sales tax, VAT, or GST on every transaction automatically

citations.quote: With Airwallex Merchant of Record, Airwallex acts as the legal seller and manages sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance for each sale.
MoR is an add-on to Airwallex's Payments product... you can enable MoR without rebuilding your integration.
